items.name: Articles of Organization (Arizona LLC)
items.quote: One or more persons may act as organizers to form a limited liability company by delivering to the commission for filing the articles of organization.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
items.feeQuote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Transaction privilege tax license and employer registration (Joint Tax Application)
items.quote: As soon as the businesses commence operations in Arizona, they must register with both agencies at the same time by completing an Arizona Joint Tax Application (Form JT-1/UC-001)

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.quote: All establishments and premises undergoing remodeling or construction must meet current code and Department requirements and follow the plan review permitting process.

items.name: Building permit and Certificate of Occupancy
items.agency: City of Phoenix Planning and Development
items.quote: A CofO is required for the following projects: New commercial and residential structures Tenant improvement of a newly occupied space

items.name: Food establishment permit
items.quote: Prior to approval of a permit to operate, the establishment and operator must demonstrate sufficient compliance with all applicable regulations.

items.name: Certified food protection manager
items.quote: Each food establishment shall have at least one (1) Certified Food Protection Manager on staff.

items.name: Employer registration for withholding and unemployment insurance (JT-1)
items.agency: Arizona Department of Revenue, with the Arizona Department of Economic Security
items.note: Added 2026-10-22, when ADOR's withholding page was read: an employer registers on the Joint Tax Application.
items.quote: Completing and submitting Arizona Form JT-1 also begins the process of registering the employer for unemployment compensation insurance

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
